fusions.name: Ossifrage
fusions.desc: Drops onto a target up to 7 tiles away for 16 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at the full 7 tiles. It uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more for each, and leaves it [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bodkin Feather
fusions.desc: Flings a hardened feather into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave it [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mantling
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 9 seconds and hops you 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Overlapping Vanes
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
